_comment: Sources for company_crawler.py. verified means safe for automatic extraction, not merely that a URL exists. Keep JavaScript-only, blocked or unscoped pages unverified. Explicit --sources opts into discovery; review output before merging. No cookies, credentials or paywall bypasses.

leetcode.label: LeetCode company tags
leetcode.notes: Upstream HEAD e095c259cfd036e3ddb6886e84d7075c2faac477 checked 2026-10-13. README dates the latest snapshot to 2026-07-12; recency buckets are relative to that date, never the crawl date.

hellointerview.label: Hello Interview
hellointerview.notes: Listing URL verified 2026-10-12. Questions require client-side rendering; generic HTML extraction is not verified. Review rendered question cards, including their company labels. Detail URLs have both a slug and an ID, so automatic following is disabled.

1point3acres.label: 1point3acres
1point3acres.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-13 across all nine company listings. Extract only visible question-link titles matching one complete catalog title; preserve the exact link. Unknown titles, longer variants, guide text and hidden content do not count. Listing dates do not establish interview dates.

gothamloop.label: Gotham Loop
gothamloop.notes: Public company guide URLs verified 2026-10-12. Guide text causes false-positive exact-title matches. Keep generic extraction unverified; review public question previews individually. No individual last-asked dates are exposed.

interviewdb.label: interviewDB
interviewdb.notes: Public listing URLs verified 2026-10-12; crawl returned public titles and relative dates. Most titles do not map unambiguously to catalog exercises; inspect public detail content before mapping. Never infer a question from its title alone.
